reasoning: The paper specifies block logits as softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d) + causal mask). The cited _build_block_index computes p_pool = einsum(pooled Q, pooled K), applies a causal -inf mask, then topk. It never applies softmax or 1/sqrt(d) scaling before ranking. The later kernel softmax only affects attention within already-selected blocks, not block selection. Thus the block-index ranking deviates from the paper.

probes.meaning: Block scores are raw pooled dot products, not softmax-scaled logits.
No softmax or sqrt scaling is applied to block scores.

would_confirm: Run _build_block_index on a small tensor and compare its selected blocks with top-k of softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d)) under the causal mask; a mismatch confirms the deviation.
